deathRate.name: Human Mortality Database (via Our World in Data)
deathRate.citation: Human Mortality Database, via Our World in Data. Deaths per 1,000 people per year. Available only for countries with long vital-registration series.

lifeExpectancyHistoric.name: Our World in Data — Long-run life expectancy
lifeExpectancyHistoric.citation: Our World in Data long-run life expectancy (Riley; Zijdeman et al.; Human Mortality Database; UN WPP). Pre-1960 estimates only; from 1960 birthrate.io uses World Bank WDI.

childMortality.name: Our World in Data — Under-five mortality
childMortality.citation: Our World in Data under-five mortality (Gapminder historical estimates + UN IGME). Deaths before age 5 per 1,000 live births (converted from OWID percent units).
